findings.description: No shipped analysis was executed: Stata is unavailable and the required direct R translation was not completed. The paper's result claims were not exhaustively enumerated or checked.
findings.evidence: The package contains Stata .do files; command lookup found no Stata executable. The publisher PDF endpoint returned HTML, preventing full text claim extraction.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the supplied Stata scripts command by command into R, run them on the supplied package data, and compare every data-derived number in the article abstract, main text, and tables.

limitations: This benchmark run is incomplete: it has no command-by-command R translation, numerical results, or exhaustive claim list.
No robustness assessment was performed; outcome_robustness is not checked.
The original package remains local at /tmp/scratch_bench_luna/packages/pkg-6165a5 and was not copied or uploaded.
